questions.unitTitle: Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa
questions.topic: Forest area and land area calculation
questions.question: Using the excerpt figures that Africa has 624 million hectares of forest which comprise 20.6 percent of the continent’s land area, calculate the approximate land area of Africa in square kilometres.
questions.explanation: Total land area = 624 million ha / 0.206 = 3,029.126 million ha = 30,291,260 km2 (1 ha = 0.01 km2); calculation uses values given in the excerpt.
questions.sourceNote: Grade 10 Geography Student Textbook, Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa (owner-connected Google Drive file 1fzhjSsBXzQ_RfmAUm8TfViZfPKLCpWWa).

questions.unitTitle: Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa
questions.question: If Africa’s population is about 1.3 billion and the average crude population density mid-2019 was about 44 people/km2 (both figures from the excerpt), estimate the continent’s land area in square kilometres.
questions.explanation: Area ≈ population / density = 1,300,000,000 ÷ 44 ≈ 29,545,454.55 km2, rounded to 29,545,455 km2, using values provided in the excerpt.
questions.sourceNote: Grade 10 Geography Student Textbook, Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa (owner-connected Google Drive file 1fzhjSsBXzQ_RfmAUm8TfViZfPKLCpWWa).

questions.unitTitle: Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa
questions.question: The excerpt states agriculture provides employment for about two-thirds of Africa’s working population. Express two-thirds as a percentage to one decimal place.
questions.explanation: Two-thirds = 2/3 = 0.666... which equals 66.666...%, rounded to one decimal place is 66.7%.
questions.sourceNote: Grade 10 Geography Student Textbook, Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa (owner-connected Google Drive file 1fzhjSsBXzQ_RfmAUm8TfViZfPKLCpWWa).

questions.unitTitle: Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa
questions.question: Convert Africa’s forest area of 624 million hectares given in the excerpt into square kilometres.
questions.explanation: 1 hectare = 0.01 km2, so 624 million ha × 0.01 = 6.24 million km2 = 6,240,000 km2, using the figure provided in the excerpt.
questions.sourceNote: Grade 10 Geography Student Textbook, Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa (owner-connected Google Drive file 1fzhjSsBXzQ_RfmAUm8TfViZfPKLCpWWa).

questions.unitTitle: Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa
questions.question: Using Table 4.10 figures in the excerpt, what is the percentage point difference between the proportion of population in urban areas in Eastern Africa (26) and Southern Africa (62)?

questions.unitTitle: Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa
questions.question: Using Table 4.9 values for Western Africa (65), Eastern Africa (65), and Sub-Saharan Africa (49), compute the average crude population density of these three regions.
questions.explanation: Average = (65 + 65 + 49) ÷ 3 = 179 ÷ 3 ≈ 59.666..., rounded to one decimal place is 59.7 people/km2, using values from Table 4.9.
questions.sourceNote: Grade 10 Geography Student Textbook, Unit 5: Major Economic and Cultural Activities of Africa (owner-connected Google Drive file 1fzhjSsBXzQ_RfmAUm8TfViZfPKLCpWWa).
